title: Training Therapeutic Judges and Multi-Agent Systems for Human-Aligned Mental Health Support
reasoning: The paper focuses on mental health support and introduces 'TheraJudge' to evaluate therapeutic responses across dimensions such as Safety, Empathy, and Guidance. While 'Safety' includes compliance with ethical norms, this is framed as professional clinical safety (harm reduction) rather than an evaluation of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or general ethical systems.
